inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read Your Cancer Moon in the Chart
inline.titleEn: Four Observable Clues in a Cancer Moon
inline.altEn: Four-step sequence: home as headquarters, protective care, the withdrawal shell, and a long emotional memory

items.subEn: They pour energy into where they live and feel off-balance when it is chaotic, cramped, or temporary.

items.nameEn: Care That Can Tip into Control
items.subEn: They show love by anticipating needs and protecting people — a real strength that, unchecked, becomes over-nurturing used to keep others close.
Under pressure they withdraw or answer indirectly, sometimes through guilt or hints, then re-emerge once they feel safe.
They hold on to both kindness and injury; old wounds can resurface years later if they were never addressed.

inline.titleEn: Cancer Moon: Common Misreadings vs Reality
inline.altEn: Side-by-side comparison of four Cancer Moon misreadings versus their accurate interpretations

linesEn: Constantly moody
Clingy or needy
Soft and passive
Fixed, unchangeable personality
High responsiveness — moods settle once safety returns
Real need is belonging — fierce loyalty as often as dependence
Cancer is cardinal — active, protective, and initiating
Describes tendencies to work with and grow around, not a locked outcome

linesEn: Element: Water
Modality: Cardinal
Ruler: The Moon

Processes life through feeling and instinct
Initiates and protects

Seeks belonging and familiar routine
Can absorb others' moods until overwhelmed
